meta.cause_summary: h82: Sweetwater below -5 C for 12 h (low -7 C) -> h84: wind turbines iced or too cold: 26% of wind fleet stopped, rising to 76% of wind fleet stopped by h169 -> h92: 1.2 GW of units failed to start in the cold -> h109: 2 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 11 h (low -10 C)), rising to 11 GW of power plants frozen (Lubbock below -5 C for 86 h (low -18 C)) by h184 -> h121: rotating outages begin (1,500 MW) -> h148: gas wells freezing (basin temp -3 C): production -10%, rising to production -25% by h181 -> h167: demand surge to 62,008 MW -> h187: reserves below 2,300 MW (671 MW) -> h205: 3 GW of gas plants without fuel -> survived with rotating outages (peak 27,705 MW)
